row.evidence: The Freshdesk pricing page lists no SCIM or user provisioning on Growth, Pro or Enterprise, and the June-cited help article "Setting up SCIM provisioning" (support.freshdesk.com article 225387) now returns 404; the only first-party provisioning doc is the Azure AD Connector App, which "sync[s] users from Active Directory to contacts or agents in Freshdesk."
row.notes: Status moved from gated to unknown: no first-party page documents Freshdesk SCIM any more. The June SCIM article (225387) returns 404, the help-centre search for "SCIM" returns no articles, and the API reference has no SCIM endpoint, so the June "Enterprise SCIM, agents only" claim is dropped. Plans: Growth $19, Pro $55, Enterprise $89 per agent/mo billed annually; the free tier no longer appears on the pricing page. SSO (SAML, OAuth2, OIDC, JWT via the Freshworks organization) is ticked on all three plans in the pricing comparison. Provisioning options: the vendor-run Azure AD Connector App (creates and deletes agents/contacts), an Aquera-built Okta connector (third party), and Google Workspace autoprovisioning listed by Google (mechanism not stated). REST API with per-agent API key on all paid plans.

scim.notes: No live first-party SCIM documentation found; the June source article (https://support.freshdesk.com/support/solutions/articles/225387-setting-up-scim-provisioning) returns 404.

endpoints.purpose: Update an agent (not name, phone, mobile or job title)

audit_log_api.notes: No audit-log endpoint in the API reference; audit logs (UI) are Enterprise-only on the pricing page.

rate_limits.text: Per account per minute: Growth 100, Pro 400, Enterprise 700; trials 50; extra calls purchasable.

limitations.text: Agent name, phone, mobile and job title cannot be updated via the API (only in the Neo Admin Center); deleting an agent downgrades them to a contact.

okta.notes: Only provisioning app is the Aquera-built connector; the Freshworks OIN app (rendered) checks SAML only.

entra.notes: Gallery app is SSO-only and says provisioning is manual; Freshdesk offers its own Azure AD Connector App (non-SCIM directory sync).

google.notes: Google lists Freshdesk autoprovisioning (suspend/hard delete) but does not say whether it uses SCIM or the Freshdesk API.

jumpcloud.notes: JumpCloud guide covers SAML SSO only.

fallbacks.other_sync: Azure AD Connector App (vendor marketplace app syncing Azure AD users to agents/contacts)
